contribution.position: On reliability, the surface metrics look healthy — 412 tests passing with 87% coverage and p99 within budget at peak — but the two sev2 incidents last quarter both traced to retry storms, and the leader-election test documented in runbook v4 has never been executed. A scheduler change touching a component whose failover path is unverified, in a system with a demonstrated retry-storm failure mode, needs that leader-election test executed and the retry behavior under the new scheduler validated before reliability can be assessed as supporting.
